FX-EXTRACT-001.says: As it starts: luminance, black point 0, white point 255, no softness: every pixel is kept, black and white too, and the frame is the drawing.

FX-EXTRACT-002.says: Black point 60: black, blue, the line, red and the soft line, all darker, turn transparent; the dark grey at 64 is kept.

FX-EXTRACT-003.says: White point 190: the light grey, the skin, white and the soft skin, all brighter, turn transparent; green at 182.4 is kept.

FX-EXTRACT-004.says: Black point 60 and white point 190: only the middle band is kept, from the dark grey to green.

FX-EXTRACT-005.says: Black point 128: grey 128, exactly on the point, is kept; grey 127 goes.

FX-EXTRACT-006.says: Black point 20 with black softness 100: blue, below 20, goes; the pixels from 20 to 120 fade in, the line faintly, red and the dark grey more; grey 127 and above are kept whole.

FX-EXTRACT-007.says: White softness 60: the pixels from 195 to 255 fade out, the skin at 219 part way, white wholly; the light grey at 192 is kept whole.

FX-EXTRACT-008.says: Invert on, black point 60: the other side: black, blue, the line, red and the soft line are kept, and every brighter pixel goes.

FX-EXTRACT-009.says: FX-EXTRACT-006 inverted: each fading pixel keeps what 006 took, so the two add up to the drawing.

FX-EXTRACT-010.says: Channel red, black point 128: red, the skins and grey 128 are kept, blue, green, the line and grey 127 go, by their red alone.

FX-EXTRACT-011.says: Channel green, black point 128: green, the skins and grey 128 are kept, red and blue go.

FX-EXTRACT-012.says: Channel blue, white point 100: blue, the skins, the greys from 127 and white go; black, red, green, the line and the dark grey are kept.

FX-EXTRACT-013.says: Channel alpha, black point 200: the two half-covered columns go, every fully covered pixel is kept whatever its colour.

FX-EXTRACT-014.says: Black point 200 above white point 100: nothing is kept.

FX-EXTRACT-015.says: Black point keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 255 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is FX-EXTRACT-001, frame 2 at 127.5 keeps grey 128 and loses grey 127, and at frame 4 only white is left.

FX-EXTRACT-016.says: White point eased from 255 at frame 0 to 0 at frame 4 on a curve that overshoots: at frame 2 it has gone below 0 and is held there, so frames 2 and 4 keep only black.

FX-EXTRACT-017.says: FX-EXTRACT-004 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-EXTRACT-018.says: Black point -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-EXTRACT-019.says: Black point 256, above 255. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-EXTRACT-020.says: White point 256, above 255. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-EXTRACT-021.says: Black softness 256, above 255. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-EXTRACT-022.says: White softness -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-EXTRACT-023.says: Channel "luma", which is not one of the five. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-EXTRACT-024.says: Channel "Red", written with a capital. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-EXTRACT-025.says: Invert "yes", which is not "on" or "off". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-EXTRACT-026.says: Black point keyed to 300 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-EXTRACT-027.says: Black point written "60", a word, not a number. The file is refused on opening, as a fault in its shape (D-215, as D-164).
